title: Companion recipe bridge status smoke
description: Validates the dev-only Farmslot recipe bridge is reachable on a connected Android or iOS device through Metro relay.

proofTargets.claim: The Mobile Companion dev build exposes the Farmslot recipe bridge to the host runner.

bridge-status.intent: Confirm the companion recipe bridge is reachable on the connected device.

show-hud.intent: Show bridge status on the device HUD overlay.
